title: Flight Erupts After Passenger’s Racist Outburst (Police Bodycam)
description:
On March 19th, 2024. An American Airlines passenger was put in a headlock and escorted off the plane in a chaotic scene after he hurled an antisemitic slur at a flight attendant.
